description: races: Find a race. GET /v1/races/search. Searches finished races by name on one timing platform. Each hit carries the ids /v1/races/events and /v1/races/results take: athlinks hits list their recent editions (event_id), runsignup hits give a race_id, raceroster hits give a numeric event_id. An empty list costs 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when events is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Serve a cached response when it is newer than this. A cache hit costs 0 credits.

platform.description: Timing platform: runsignup, athlinks (also carries ChronoTrack events) or raceroster.

year.description: Only races held in this four-digit year.

name: races_search
